Game Overview

In Tilted, the core idea is straightforward: tilted offers an imaginative adventure where players manipulate entire mazes by tilting them, using gravity to guide their ball to the finish line. With 20 challenging levels, players must strategically shift the environment, relying on precision and timing to master unique puzzles that reinvent the platformer experience.
